depicts: A waterfall falling from a rock ledge into a dark green forest pool, with ferns and boulders in the foreground and evergreen trees above.
composition: Waterfall sits right of centre at the far edge of the pool; pool fills the middle; ferns frame the left and lower right; rock walls fill the top. Nothing is cut off as a subject.
tone_and_contrast: Dark teal water and shadowed rock against bright green ferns and foliage; waterfall is a pale vertical streak against dark rock. Strong light-dark and colour separation.
sharpness_and_artifacts: Ferns and rocks look detailed at full size; waterfall has a smooth long-exposure blur. No watermarks, overlays, HUD or baked-in margins visible.
scan_first_read: A natural waterfall and forest pool scene framed by ferns.
